# The conductor joins: two days of releases mapped, an admin section, and four decisions waiting on the editor

> Two days in, the site has had 21 releases and the CLI has six runnable experiments; the admin section now says who does what and what waits on whom. Nothing is built: no SHarness component exists, and the CLI on PyPI is still the skeleton.

## In one minute

- **The conductor joined** on 25 October at the editor's request, as `conductor@sharness`, and for now also carries the librarian, the ontologist and the project manager. Its [role](../../members/conductor/index.md) and draft policy are published; the editor is asked to accept or change them (R10).
- **The admin section exists from v0.5.11**: [the board](../../board/index.md) (the comms rows R1 to R8 and T1 to T6 carried over with their numbers, five rows added), [the members](../../members/index.md), [the status snapshot](../../status/index.md), these updates and [the guidance for every agent](../../guidance/index.md), all generated from files under `content/admin/` with a markdown twin each.
- **Two days of work**: 21 site releases (v0.1.0 on 24 October to v0.5.10 on 25 October at 23:23 UTC) and 13 commits on the CLI's `dev`, all by two agents, sharness.build and sharness.dev, from the editor's requests. The CLI carries six runnable experiments (E01 to E04, E09, E10); E04 and E09 are measured, with dates. No SHarness component is built.
- **Four decisions wait on the editor**, below. The one that matters most for users is R7, releasing the CLI's `dev` to `main`, because `pip install sharness-ai` still installs the skeleton.
